name: Manage Skill
description: Create or update reusable skill playbooks distilled from experience.

function.name: manage_skill
function.description:
Create, edit, patch, or delete a reusable skill (SKILL.md playbook) in the local skill library. Use after multi-step work when a durable procedure, fix pattern, or user preference about how to do a *class* of tasks should persist. Prefer patching an existing class-level skill over creating narrow one-off skills.

Actions:
- create: new skill (skill_id, description, body required)
- edit: replace SKILL.md fields or full content
- patch: unique find-and-replace in SKILL.md or a support file
- write_file: add references/templates/scripts/assets support file
- delete: remove a library skill you created

When NOT to use: greetings, one-shot Q&A, environment glitches ('command not found'), or transient failures that already resolved. Capture the durable FIX pattern, not 'tool X is broken'.

display_name.description: Human name for create/edit (defaults to skill_id).

description.description: Short trigger blurb — when to load this skill.

content.description: Full SKILL.md including frontmatter (edit), or support file text (write_file).

overwrite.description: create only: replace existing skill id if present.

agent_id.description: Optional agent to assign the new skill to.
